description: SYNTHETIC. Each cell against itself across the two halves; a paired test.
methods: Wilcoxon signed-rank on corrected_mean_median; unit of replication = cell; second_half n=3, first_half n=3; unit of replication = cell: cells within one movie are not independent samples and the pseudoreplication risk should be reported explicitly; benjamini_hochberg correction within family 'parity_window', alpha = 0.05.
